paragraphs.text: Crown Technical Systems proposes to supply arc-resistant metal-clad medium voltage (MV) switchgear for the Syracuse Airport project. The proposed equipment includes a two-section 15 kV arc-resistant metal-clad lineup, designed to meet the requirements specified in the RFP for switchgear components and accessories.

The switchgear will be equipped with eighteen 15 kV vacuum circuit breaker positions, protective relays and controls, two revenue meter positions, two sets of 15 kV isolation switches, bus voltage transformers (VTs), and multi-ratio current transformers (CTs). This configuration ensures compliance with the functional and operational system requirements outlined in the RFP.

Additionally, the proposer will furnish standard catalog termination kits, including NEMA four-hole pads and insulating boots, to accommodate incoming and outgoing cable connections for up to two 750 MCM 15 kV cables per phase. These accessories are integral to the complete and functional system.
